# WRAP.

> GitHub contribution wrap by Hritik Raj (@rhrits). Built in India.

WRAP. is a free web app that turns any public GitHub contribution calendar into a forest heatmap, harbor fleet, skyline, or commit current. Users can inspect days, unlock awards, download a wrap image, and share a thought.

## Product
- Name: WRAP.
- Category: Developer tool / GitHub visualization
- Price: Free (INR 0)
- Origin: India
- Author: Hritik Raj (@rhrits)
- Source: https://github.com/rhrits/github-contribution-wrap

## How to use
Open the site, enter a GitHub username (or `/?u=username`), and WRAP. loads public contribution years.
